issues.message: Headline 'BUY ETFs COMM' is truncated — the word 'COMMISSION' is cut off mid-word, and the expected 'FREE!' line is missing entirely. Source shows the same truncation issue but the variant does not resolve it for the 300x250 format.
CTA label reads 'START INV' — truncated mid-word. The full call-to-action (e.g. 'START INVESTING') is not legible, undermining the primary conversion element.
CTA pill sits very close to the right and bottom canvas edges with minimal padding (<16px), reducing breathing room at this small format.
Because both the headline and CTA labels are truncated, the visual hierarchy fails to communicate the offer — the eye lands on incomplete text, weakening the reading order.

Composition mirrors the source (logo top-left, headline center, CTA bottom-right, disclaimer bottom-left) and the headline appears marginally less clipped than the source, but the core truncation problem persists.

notes: Variant preserves brand palette, typography, and layout faithfully, but both the headline and CTA suffer from text truncation at the 300x250 format, which is a blocking issue for shippability.
